outcomes.text: Understand written texts, including the meanings of words and phrases.
Summarise texts and adapt material for a specific context.
Develop, analyse and evaluate facts, ideas and opinions.
Explain how writers create effects and influence readers.
Select information that is appropriate for particular purposes.
Recognise and respond to linguistic devices, figurative language and imagery.
Study twentieth- and twenty-first-century literature, fiction, non-fiction and varied text types across different genres.
Examine writers’ language, style, effects and influence, including facts, ideas, perspectives, opinions and bias.
Communicate thoughts, feelings and imaginative ideas.
Organise and communicate facts, ideas and opinions effectively.
Use a varied vocabulary suited to the context.
Use sentence structures effectively and with variety.
Adapt writing to its audience, purpose and form.
Use accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar.
Create and compose descriptive, narrative, discursive, argumentative and persuasive texts for varied purposes.
